predecessors.name: Western Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Lusitania and Carthaginensis, where Respendial's Alans settled

successors.name: Vandals
successors.text: the Hasdingi kingdom in Gallaecia, whose king Gunderic accepted the Alan crown

successors.name: Western Roman Empire
successors.text: the Alan lands in Lusitania and Carthaginensis

ledger.x: 418: the Visigoths kill the Alan king Attaces.

wars.name: Visigothic campaign against the Alans in Hispania
wars.outcome: The Visigoths, as Roman federates, killed the Alan king Attaces in battle; the survivors appealed to Gunderic's Vandals.

certainty.note: A settlement zone of a people on the move, not a border: no page gives a boundary for Lusitania and Carthaginensis.
